detail.canon_phrase: pairing is the eigenbasis/eigenform of the native successor
detail.first_missing_equation: P_t(delta_x,delta_y) or P_t(delta_x,chi_b) as an explicit function of the successor spectral data, with B/Q/L covariance and L block extension.
detail.fixed_factor_clue: For s_D on Z/DZ, characters chi_b are forced eigenvectors and the normalized Fourier kernel is a constrained descendant after choosing C and normalization.
detail.type_problem: A pairing is a bilinear or sesquilinear map; an eigenbasis is a basis. The source does not state whether P is evaluation in the eigencharacter basis, a Gram form diagonalized by that basis, or the Fourier transition kernel.
